blocks.label: Overview
bullets: Contains Certified Organic Cocoa, Cordyceps & Reishi
No Added Colors, Sugars or Sweeteners
paragraphs: California Gold Nutrition® Superfoods CocoCeps® is a premium, certified organic (non-alkalized) Dark Cocoa beverage, containing Cordyceps and Reishi mushrooms. This naturally energizing blend is perfect for drinking or baking and makes a great addition to a healthy diet and active lifestyle!

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Mix 1 scoop daily with 4-8 ounces of warm/hot liquid (preferably purified water) and stir, sweetening if desired. Please note that this product is quite bitter due to its naturally occurring polyphenol compounds, and may be used unsweetened if desired.
Note: 8 grams per scoop is an average. Individual scooping technique may yield slightly less than or slightly more than 8 grams.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Due to the naturally derived ingredients in this product, taste, color, and consistency may vary. This whole-food based beverage blend was not formulated to be 100% soluble in liquids. Naturally occurring sediment is normal.
Sealed for your protection. Do not use if seal is missing or broken. Store in a cool, dry place. Protect from heat, light, and moisture.
THIS PRODUCT IS PACKAGED AND SOLD BY WEIGHT, NOT BY VOLUME. SETTLING OF CONTENTS OCCURS OVER TIME.
